simple.meaning: בַּעַל שָׁלִשָׁה (Baʻal Shâlishâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “Baal of Shalishah , Baal-Shalishah, a place in Palestine.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.

simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to בַּעַל שָׁלִשָׁה (H1190) in the Hebrew text.
